## Top-down release proof

- [ ] Customer outcome is demonstrated, or marked Not applicable with a reason.
- [ ] Product/data contracts and compatibility are documented.
- [ ] Engine modules, commands, migrations, IDs, and layers are identified.
- [ ] Art/assets have declared perspective, ownership, and deterministic source/hash evidence.
- [ ] Home Assistant/Site/tablet integration and privacy boundaries are checked.
- [ ] Automated verification passed with exact commands/results recorded below.
- [ ] Deployment was backed up and read back, or marked source-only with a reason.
- [ ] Rollback input and procedure are known.

## Deterministic evidence

- Source commit:
- `roomcraft-release-manifest.json` root digest:
- Tests/types/build:
- Visual or target-device checks:
- Generated artifacts regenerated and clean:

## Documentation and safety

- [ ] Changelog and relevant decision/handoff/user documentation are updated.
- [ ] No token, password, private entity inventory, camera media, personal identifier, or private backup path is included.
- [ ] No household device was operated unless that physical test was explicitly planned and recorded.

See [`docs/release-standard.md`](../../home-assistant/projects/roomcraft/docs/release-standard.md) for the required order and customer acceptance matrix.
